scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run build --workspace @api-client/web && npm run start --workspace @api-client/desktop
scripts.compose:selfhosted:config: docker compose --env-file .env.selfhosted -f compose.yaml -f compose.selfhosted.yaml -f compose.npm-proxy.yaml config --quiet
scripts.compose:selfhosted:up: docker compose --env-file .env.selfhosted -f compose.yaml -f compose.selfhosted.yaml -f compose.npm-proxy.yaml up -d --build --wait
scripts.compose:selfhosted:down: docker compose --env-file .env.selfhosted -f compose.yaml -f compose.selfhosted.yaml -f compose.npm-proxy.yaml down
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run build --workspace @api-client/api && npm run build --workspace @api-client/proxy && npm run build --workspace @api-client/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run build --workspace @api-client/web && npm run build --workspace @api-client/desktop
scripts.make:windows: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run build --workspace @api-client/web && npm run make --workspace @api-client/desktop -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @api-client/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run compose:config:ci
